name: Woodpaw Investigation
summary: At Camp Mojache, Hadoken Swiftstrider suspects the Woodpaw gnolls are following written plans. He sends you south to search their camps for battle plans.

sections.title: A Search for Plans
sections.body: After Alpha Strike, Hadoken Swiftstrider sends you back to the Woodpaw. He doubts the gnolls are clever, yet their recent assaults have been too well coordinated to be chance. He suspects they keep a written record of their strategy. If you find it, he may learn what stirred them up, so he asks you to search the camps and bring back anything that looks like battle plans.

sections.title: What the Map Shows
sections.body: The map gives Hadoken the plans he sought. Arrows cross it and may mark troop movements, though most point south, away from Camp Mojache to the north. Elsewhere, a drawing resembles a large insect. Tick marks beneath it may count gnoll losses to unknown bugs.

faq.q: Who sends you to investigate the Woodpaw gnolls?
faq.answer: Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache sends you to investigate the Woodpaw gnolls.

faq.q: Why does Hadoken believe the gnolls have battle plans?
faq.answer: The Woodpaw's recent assaults have been too well coordinated to be improvised. Hadoken expects a written strategy that could show what stirred them up.

faq.q: Where are the battle plans located?
aliases: where to find woodpaw battle map
faq.answer: The battle plans are in the Woodpaw camps south of Camp Mojache.
Alpha Strike comes right before this search.
